title: Bound four donors for the owned 1548 repair
body:
## Result

**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** On exact #7481, remove owned1548’s rank-one MOVE39785 and the two old recipient ADDs. Advance the existing paid moves of roles 913 and 1298 to chart 127 before ADD46664. Test whether four unchanged donors, 913, 1197, 587 and 1494, can restore both receivers at that cut.

Input x164=4 zeros every offered donor while the required correction is +1 for each receiver. Independent normalized forward replay gives old and unrepaired values 7/8 and −1/8 after ADD46664, and 0 and −1 after ADD47723. Injecting the exact required value restores both reads, and reversing its sign fails both. One case exhausted with zero unresolved in scope. Other donors, joint recipient edits, changed encoding and physical retirement remain open.

## Exact sources and replay

Canonical base e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. Exact #7481 at 89eaa9d8cae37c1540de98f2d29a3abaabb96a2b and signed #7113 at 07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d. The hypothetical edit removes 17 rank-one jobs across 17 native calls with productive counts fixed. One new rank-one job per call consumes the gross. The two #7257 CI prerequisites are separate ancestor commits.

From a clean POSIX checkout with CPython 3.12:

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-owned1548-two-recipient-bound/replay.py
```

Expect `PASS_OWNED1548_TWO_RECIPIENT_BOUND`. Exact cut solve and independent literal normalized replay finished within 30 seconds each. Direct, registered, read-only Git-free export, exact source and mode checks and 27 local onboarding tests passed on the same tree. No positive candidate reached signed physical or complete application replay.

## Credit and open questions

#7481/#7480/#7334 supply the native lineage, #7113 the signed caller, #7482 exact covectors, #7298 directed pricing and #7508 pinned public input bytes. #7491 covers other single-recipient terminal cuts, #7500 a different owner, and #7529 a fixed historical repair in chart 246. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted proof, implementation, independent verification and packaging.

A further test needs a named earlier encoding and its already-paid path, with both first outward values and each original carrier restored at its deadline.
